correctness.rationale: PASS: On planar no-slip unit channel, write u=6qy(1-y)+F prime, F in clamped H0², so exact energy E=12q²+||F double-prime||² and Taylor objective ||qf+F||², f=3y²-2y³-y odd about midpoint. The first clamped-beam eigenmode e1 is simple and midpoint-even, eigenvalue alpha^4 for alpha the least positive root cos(alpha)cosh(alpha)=1. Hence forcing has zero projection there. The unique odd stationary family F=q(G_k-f), 0<k<=alpha, increases strictly in excess energy to s_c. Exact equal-energy identity ||qf+F||²-||qf+F*||²=||F-F*||²-mu||(F-F*) double-prime||² and sharp beam inequality prove unique symmetric optimum below/at E_c and exactly two mirror optimizers ±sqrt(E-E_c)e1 prime above, with high-energy linear optimal Taylor correction. Independently computed alpha=4.730040744862704..., s_c=0.370205669468391..., t_c=0.006144379658716..., matching analytic forms. These finite quadratures confirm constants, whereas global optimality is proved spectrally.
